requirements.requirement: The system must include a proximity_score field (0–1 normalized float) for each clinical trial result returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must include proximity metadata fields (distance_meters, duration_seconds, chosen_site_id) alongside the proximity_score for each trial.
The system must retrieve proximity scoring outputs from clinical_trials_service and map them into the evaluate_care_facade response without loss of precision.
The system must ensure that for trials with multiple locations, the proximity metadata corresponds to the selected best-case site used in scoring.
The system must preserve existing response schema compatibility so that tool_router outputs remain valid without breaking changes.
The system must include proximity_score only when scoring data is available and omit or null the field when unavailable.
The system must ensure that all proximity-related fields conform to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-M5-S1.
The system must return clinical trial results within existing latency thresholds after adding proximity scoring fields.
The system must gracefully handle cases where clinical_trials_service returns no proximity data by returning trials without proximity fields and without raising errors.
The system must log an error event when proximity scoring integration fails for a trial while still returning the base trial data.
The system must ensure that proximity_score values are deterministic for the same input data across repeated API calls.
The system must expose proximity metadata in a format consumable by downstream LLM/tool_router components without requiring additional transformation.
